questions.title: Does the manual state these troubleshooting facts?

source.text: TABLE COLUMNS: Fault number | Fault name | Possible fault | Troubleshooting
Fault number: 6 | Fault name: No current compensation/Bad current compensation | Possible fault: The CT is not well connected. | Troubleshooting: Check if the CT wiring is cor- rect.

proposal: 1. FailureMode 'CT is not well connected' -> AFFECTS -> Component 'CT wiring'. Meaning: The failure mode affects the specified component.

options.label: Yes, all correct
options.effect: all statements enter the graph as verified

options.label: No, none is stated
options.effect: the statements stay out of the graph

options.label: Only some are correct
options.effect: only the statement numbers you list enter the graph

questions.title: Page 65 has no readable text next to diagnostic pages: should it be transcribed?
proposal: Page 65 is probably a figure or a scan; the system could not read it.

options.label: Skip it
options.effect: the page stays out of the graph

options.label: Transcribe it
options.effect: your transcription is kept in the run report for the next extraction

answers.rationale: The table identifies a poorly connected CT as the possible fault and directs checking the CT wiring, supporting the stated relationship to CT wiring.
